MERN Stack Developer Intern
description:
**MERN Stack Developer Intern**

We are looking for a passionate **MERN Stack Developer Intern** to join our team. This internship offers a great opportunity to gain **hands\-on experience in full\-stack development** using the **MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)** and work on exciting real\-world projects.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Assist in developing and maintaining web applications using the **MERN Stack**
* Write clean, efficient, and scalable code for both **frontend and backend**
* Collaborate with design and development teams to build **user\-friendly interfaces**
* Test, debug, and optimize applications for better performance
* Develop and integrate **RESTful APIs** with frontend components
* Manage and work with **MongoDB databases**
* Stay updated with the latest **full\-stack development trends and technologies**

**Required Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of **MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js**
* Understanding of **HTML, CSS, JavaScript**
* Familiarity with **REST API development**
* Knowledge of **Git version control**
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills
* Understanding of **responsive design and cross\-platform compatibility**
* Willingness to learn new tools and technologies

**Educational Qualification:**

* Pursuing or completed **Computer Science / IT** or related degree

**Benefits:**  
✔ Hands\-on experience in **MERN Stack development**  
✔ Mentorship from experienced professionals  
✔ Opportunity to work on **live projects**  
✔ **Internship Certificate** upon completion  
✔ Potential **Full\-Time Job Opportunity**

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher, Internship

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
